title: Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) Recalculation and Review Schedule
content:
# Recalculation and Review Schedule

Billing operations schedule for Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): the recalculation method of each plan, how often a scheduled recalculation falls, the percentages that govern a scheduled review, the deferred balances at which an unscheduled recalculation is made, and whether a board-approved rate change brings a recalculation.

## Schedule

| Plan | Recalculation method | Months between scheduled recalculations | Variance trigger (percent) | Largest change at one scheduled review (percent) | Deferred debit that brings an unscheduled recalculation | Deferred credit that brings an unscheduled recalculation | Rate change brings a recalculation on the next bill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | rolling average | 1 | 0 | 0 (no limit) | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | fixed annual | 12 | 0 | 0 (no limit) | $250.00 | $250.00 | Yes |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | quarterly review | 3 | 10 | 25 | $200.00 | $200.00 | Yes |
| Farm Budget Billing | semiannual review | 6 | 15 | 25 | $400.00 | $400.00 | Yes |
| Small Business Budget Billing | quarterly review | 3 | 10 | 25 | $500.00 | $500.00 | Yes |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | fixed annual | 12 | 0 | 0 (no limit) | $250.00 | $250.00 | Yes |

## Key to the columns

- **Recalculation method.** One of four: rolling average, fixed annual, quarterly review or semiannual review.
- **Months between scheduled recalculations.** 1 on the rolling average plan, 3 on the quarterly review plans, 6 on the semiannual review plan and 12 on the fixed annual plans.
- **Variance trigger.** The percent by which the recalculated installment must differ from the current one for a scheduled review to change it. A figure of 0 means the recalculated amount always replaces the current one.
- **Largest change at one scheduled review.** The largest percent change of the installment at one scheduled review. A figure of 0 means there is no limit.
- **Deferred debit and deferred credit columns.** The deferred debit, and the deferred credit taken as an absolute value, at which an unscheduled recalculation is made. The rolling average plan shows $0.00 in both because it recalculates monthly.
- **Rate change.** On every plan a board-approved rate change brings a recalculation on the next bill.

## Reading across a row (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical:* on Farm Budget Billing a scheduled recalculation falls every 6 months. The row shows a variance trigger of 15 percent and a largest change of 25 percent, and an unscheduled recalculation once the deferred debit reaches $400.00 or the deferred credit reaches $400.00 in absolute value.

*Hypothetical:* on Small Business Budget Billing the same columns read every 3 months, 10 percent, 25 percent and $500.00.
